item: Repository review
finding: Repo contained a single 5-byte README.md ("# FL3") and one commit; there was no prior code, data or configuration to review, and COORDINATION.md did not exist

item: Standings table columns
finding: The static HTML render of nfl.com/standings/ emits the numeric columns without their header row, so HOME/ROAD/DIV/CONF/STRK values are present but unlabelled; only W/L/T/PCT/PF/PA/NET were accepted (they are pinned by arithmetic identities: PF-PA=NET, PCT=W/(W+L))
action_required: Re-read with a browser render or the labelled table so the remaining columns can be published

item: Fetch fragility
finding: https://www.nfl.com/standings/at-a-glance/?season=2026&seasonType=REG and /standings/at-a-glance/ both return the league's 404 page to a static (non-JS) fetch, while /standings/ renders
action_required: Automation must use the /standings/<division|conference|league>/<year>/REG paths and alert on a 404 body

item: nfl.com JSON API
finding: https://api.nfl.com/feed/schedule/league/2026/reg returns 401 Unauthorized to the unauthenticated fetcher, so the natural machine-readable endpoint is not usable without partner credentials
action_required: Owner decision: obtain credentials, or rely on HTML scraping of the schedule pages

item: Injury report omits IR players
finding: The Week 10 Ravens report lists 8 players, none with a game status, while the official news feed on the same page states Lamar Jackson is expected to miss 6-10 weeks. Players on IR do not appear on the weekly report, so a report-only 'deficiency' count reads as 'Baltimore fully healthy'
action_required: Must merge transactions/IR feed (S-08) before any availability signal is trusted

McCarthy on NYG, Von Miller and Aaron Donald on the Dallas/LA reports, Bobby Okereke and Jaelan Phillips on CAR, Kenneth Walker III and Justin Fields on KC). Each is either a real 2026 transaction or a feed error; we do not assume either

item: Position field unreliable
finding: Patrick O'Connell is listed as LB on the Seahawks report; he is a quarterback. Position-derived rules (OL group, DB group) inherit this error

item: Blank injury field with a game status
finding: Hunter Henry (NE) is listed Questionable with an empty injury field on the Week 10 report, while the C.J. West / A.J. Brown style rows carry full injury text. Blank does not mean 'no injury'

item: Practice status conflicts with game status
finding: Rows where a player practised fully and is still Out (JAX BJ Green II) or practised fully and is Questionable (NYJ Garrett Wilson, KC Kenneth Walker III, MIA Darrell Baker Jr.) are common. The report is a disclosure rule, not a medical prediction
action_required: Signals must use trajectory + designation jointly (SIG-02); never treat FP as 'fine'

item: No official source for odds
finding: No NFL-controlled page publishes point spreads, totals, moneylines or prop prices (F-14), so every market-price cell in this repo is intentionally blank and every CLV gate is marked blocked
action_required: Approve a licensed odds vendor (SRC-016) or accept a model that can never be scored against the market

item: Week 1 header/weekday mismatch
finding: The Week 1 page labels the NE-SEA opener as "Sunday Night Football, September 9th" while the game line and card read "Wednesday, September 9th" (9 Sep 2026 is a Wednesday). We published the weekday as printed and flagged it
action_required: Confirm the kickoff date/time from the league's important-dates page before using rest-day arithmetic on that game

item: Clubs that appear to hold players from other rosters
finding: Alias of FLG-006 used as the row-level marker inside data/injuries_2026_w10.csv (flag column)

item: Chiefs backfield row
finding: Kenneth Walker III is listed Questionable (groin, DNP) on the Kansas City report; the official news roundup on the same page describes 'Kenneth Walker questionable' without a club - the pairing is consistent, so this row is kept, but the roster move that put him in KC is unverified

item: Unlabelled stat columns
finding: nfl.com team-stats pages publish 15 (passing) and 10 (rushing) numeric columns with no header text in the static render. Columns were mapped only where an arithmetic identity pins them (e.g. CMP% = cmp/att to 0.1, YDS/ATT = yds/att, 1ST% = 1st/att). 11 of 39 columns are therefore withheld, including rushing TD and fumbles, in data/team_*_2026.csv
action_required: Re-scrape with labels, or licence the official stats feed; do not guess a column from its magnitude

item: Defense scoring page is not points allowed
finding: /stats/team-stats/defense/scoring/2026/reg/all returns three tiny integer columns (defensive touchdowns, safeties etc.), not points allowed; points against must come from the standings PF/PA
action_required: Remove this page from the planned fetch list

item: Season incomplete
finding: data/games_2026.csv holds 32 of the 137 games verified through Week 9 (Weeks 1-2 only). Every distributional number on the site (margin SD, home advantage, push rate) is therefore computed on n=32 and labelled provisional
action_required: Run scripts/fetch_nfl_data.py weeks 3-18 on a networked host, then rebuild

item: No snap counts or depth charts
finding: '2nd/3rd/4th string backup replacing a starter' cannot be computed from any league-published feed: the report gives a designation, not a lineup. No official depth-chart requirement exists
action_required: Decide the source for lineup inference: club charts (32 scrapes/day) or a licensed feed

item: Weather not integrated
finding: No venue, roof or weather data is in the repo, so no total can be considered fully specified for Nov-Dec outdoor games (and the two 2026 international fixtures), despite being cheap to obtain from a government source
action_required: Add NWS fetch + a venue table with roof type per club

item: Overtime rule corroboration is not official
finding: The 2026 rulebook page lists only the four 2026 amendments (6-1-3, 6-1-5, 6-1-6, 19-2); the regular-season OT possession change we rely on for tie probability is described only by secondary media (SRC-014)
action_required: Read Rule 16 in the official 2026 PDF (link stored in SRC-010) and store the text

item: Roster rules unconfirmed
finding: Secondary sources disagree on 2026 roster numbers (game-day actives 47/48, practice squad 16 vs 17, two vs three elevations). Nothing is published in this repo as a fact
action_required: Read the rulebook roster/inactive articles plus the CBA roster section; leave values blank until then

item: A tied game exists that we have not ingested
finding: NYG and WAS each show T=1 in the standings while the league total tie count is 1 (2 tie records / 2). The tied game must therefore involve both clubs, and it is not in Weeks 1-2, so it sits in the un-ingested Weeks 3-9 window
action_required: Confirm from the Week 3-9 schedule pages; tie frequency is a real pricing input for spreads and moneylines

item: Headlines read, articles not opened
finding: The availability context (Jackson 6-10 weeks, Darnold out/Lock starting, Willis to IR, Nacua IR, Jacobs surgery) comes from the link text on the injury page, not from the article bodies
action_required: Open each article and store the quoted sentence with the URL before using it as an input

item: No licence file

action_required: Owner decision on licence (flagged, not chosen for you)

item: Sandbox cannot run the fetchers
finding: The agent sandbox blocks nfl.com and GitHub release assets (probe recorded in COORDINATION.md), so scripts/fetch_nfl_data.py has never been executed here; it is untested code and is labelled as such
action_required: Run it once on a networked host and paste the log into data/raw_evidence/ before trusting the auto-refresh

item: League offense and defense tables disagree on scoring events
finding: sum(pass TD) over the 32 official offense rows = 414 but sum(pass TD allowed) over the 32 defense rows = 415; sum(INT thrown) = 202 vs sum(INT forced) = 200. Every volume identity (attempts 9037, completions 5787, yards 64098, 1st downs 3026, sacks 643) matches exactly, so this is not a column-mapping error: the two published tables are inconsistent with each other on scoring/turnover totals (late stat corrections, or a transcription error in one of the 64 rows).
action_required: Re-read both pages and diff the four columns; until they agree, pass_td / pass_int / opp_pass_td / opp_int_forced stay pricing-ineligible (verify.py reports V-09b FAIL, non-blocking).

item: Calibration constants are not yet identified
finding: Fitting the rating-gap-to-points conversion on the 33 verified games returns beta = 1.140 +/- 0.271 (beta >= 1 means the ratings are being *amplified* instead of shrunk) and the total-model exponent gamma pinned at the search-grid boundary (1.20), with r2 = 0.364. Both are signatures of an in-sample fit on too few games, not evidence about football.
action_required: Do not clamp or hand-set these. Re-estimate out-of-sample after Weeks 3-18 are ingested (Q-04), then on 5 seasons; until then every price carries provisional-fitted-not-bettable.

item: Pages deployment mode is legacy branch build (main /docs), not GitHub Actions
finding: The repo's Pages settings returned build_type=legacy with source=main/docs. Attempting to switch it to build_type=workflow from the token available in this session failed with HTTP 403 'Resource not accessible by integration'. The deploy therefore happens because docs/ is committed, and .github/workflows/site.yml is a verification gate rather than the publisher.
action_required: Owner (admin) can switch to Actions-based deployment in Settings -> Pages if a deploy log inside Pages is wanted; until then keep docs/ committed and the workflow green. The workflow file documents the exact steps to add upload/deploy-pages later.

item: Baltimore and Los Angeles (Chargers) publish no game-status designation for the Week 10 Monday game
finding: The Week 10 report yields game-status rows for 26 of the 28 clubs on the slate. The two exceptions are exactly the teams that play each other on Monday night (LAC at BAL): the Ravens' section lists rows carrying practice designations but no Out/Doubtful/Questionable value, and the Chargers' section contributes none. An availability count built from this file therefore reads 0 'Out' for both clubs, which is an absence of disclosure (and, for BAL, a consequence of injured players being on IR - see FLG-005) and not evidence of health.
action_required: Do not treat a zero count as 'healthy' for these two clubs. Read the BAL rows' practice designations and the transactions log (Q-03), and label the LAC@BAL availability_flags as unreported on the lines page. | 2026-11-16 UPDATE: superseded. The official Week 10 report lists game-status entries for 10 Chargers players and 2 Ravens players (see FLG-031 for the cells this repo table lacks).
